    Walks in a string diagram #

    A directed walk in the string diagram of a word without forks runs along a segment of consecutive letters, all direct (moving right) or all inverse (moving left), and its coefficient is one (follow_eq_some_iff). Consequently the start and end positions of a walk determine the path it spells (follow_unique). These are the "directed segments" of Section 3.

    The letters r, r + 1, … are the direct letters of l.
